title: AI-Learn：AI学习资源合集
summary: 一个涵盖Python、数学、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络、LLM、RAG、提示词、Agent及AIOS等主题的AI学习资源仓库，以Jupyter Notebook形式组织，适合系统性学习人工智能相关知识。
summary_en: A comprehensive AI learning repository covering Python, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, LLM, RAG, prompts, agents, and AIOS, organized as Jupyter Notebooks for systematic AI study.
